answer: Agents such as atlas, tide and willow allocate shared jobs through a lottery weighted by tokens locked in escrow, with no bonus for opening an account. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake identities gives the same total chance of winning as staking all 100 under one identity. To capture more jobs, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens for the full escrow period, tying up capital that cannot be spent or staked elsewhere.
